title: Welcome to the New ViviMusic Update!
summary: Check out the latest features, improved audio playback, video previews, and UI enhancements.
content:
### What's New in ViviMusic

We are excited to introduce our new **Expressive Announcements** channel!

#### Highlights:
- **Adaptive Home Card**: Beautifully styled cards that adapt whether you have images or not.
- **Full Video & Media Preview**: Watch update previews directly in the app.
- **Hyperlink Support**: Quickly tap links to join discussions, report bugs, or view source code.

Visit our [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/ViviMusicGroup/vivi-music) or join the community.

Enjoy streaming with ViviMusic!
